children: Pacific Oak Strategic Opportunity REIT disclosed interim IFRS financials showing a $118.8 million net loss and significant working capital shortfalls tied to maturing Series B and D bonds.
Filed English translations of IFRS consolidated and separate interim financials for three and six months to June 30, 2026.
Reported net loss of $118.8M for six months ended June 30, 2026; owner's deficit of $38.0M as of June 30, 2026.
Working capital shortfall of $553.2M due to near‑term maturities including Series B & D bonds totaling ₪975.3M ($327.5M).
Company not in compliance with multiple Series B and D bond covenants and is operating under a standstill agreement while negotiating a debt arrangement.
Post-period actions include sale of Richardson land for $12.2M and ongoing negotiations, defaults and potential remedies at 110 William joint venture.
